title: cdr-observation.v1
description: One CDR the CDR consumer received, reduced to what the `cdr_mismatch` join compares. The run directory holds them as JSON lines in `cdrs.jsonl`. Times are Unix epoch milliseconds. ADR-0049.

call_id.description: The Call-ID of the caller's INVITE as the system under test received it: the join key with the call-outcome record.

answer_ms.description: Null when the CDR records no answer.

duration_ms.description: The answered duration the CDR states, converted to milliseconds; 0 for a call never answered.

duration_unit_ms.description: The resolution of the CDR's own duration field (1000 for whole seconds). The join allows 1 s plus this unit.

disposition.description: `answered` or `not_answered`, as the CDR states it.

final_code.description: The final the caller received, when the CDR states it.
